$comment: Tables authored Convex code may write directly (scripts/check-governed-writes.ts). Everything else changes only through generated Manifest commands. Each entry says why the table stays outside Manifest. Created 2026-09-29.

eventNumberSequences.reason: Per-tenant event number counter. Allocated inside the emitting command's transaction by handleManifestEvent on EventPlanned/EventNumberSet; a command cannot read and bump a sibling counter row. IR entity is storage-only (eventNumberSequenceSeamOnly).

eventNumberAssignments.reason: The number allocated to one event, written with the counter bump in the same transaction so Event.planEngagement keeps a single version bump. Storage-only IR entity.

invoiceNumberSequences.reason: Per-tenant invoice number counter minted inside the invoice command's transaction (convex/lib/invoiceNumbering.ts). Storage-only IR entity (invoiceNumberSequenceSeamOnly).

materializationReceipts.reason: Idempotency receipts for authored multi-row materialization transactions; they record that a batch of generated commands already ran and carry no domain state. Storage-only IR entity (materializationReceiptSeamOnly).

externalRecordLinks.reason: One-time data migration only (importCommit.backfillLinkKeys, 2026-09-29): stamps the derived linkKey index key — a pure function of the row's own identity fields, no domain meaning, no event — on link rows written before findLink/upsertLink read the by_linkKey index. It stays while a deployment may still hold unstamped rows; delete it (and this entry) once every deployment has run it. Every other link write goes through generated ExternalRecordLink commands.

eventPacketIssues.reason: Derived cache: issues are recomputed deterministically from the current event packet snapshot on every packet write. No human input and no domain transition.
